Roof Repairs and Chimneys

We repair roofs and chimneys: broken and slipped tiles, leaks, ridge tiles, dry ridge and dry verge, valleys and leadwork, chimney repointing, cowls and taking a stack down. We come out, find what's causing the problem and show you before we fix it.

Call 01472 306134 WhatsApp Us

Ridge Tiles and Dry Ridge

Loose or cracked ridge tiles get re-bedded and repointed, or taken off and fixed back down with a dry ridge system. The photos show dry ridge on red and grey tile roofs, and a ridge being re-bedded in mortar. Paul K in Mablethorpe had his dry ridge taken off and replaced, a customer in Scunthorpe had dry ridge fitted to a porch, and we've repointed ridge tiles in Grimsby and Hull.

Dry Verge on Gables

Dry verge runs down the gable end where the edge of the roof used to be held in cement. Richard N in York had one fitted where the cement had gone. In Hull, Joshua L booked us for a dry verge, and when the team got there they found the roof needed more work before the verge could go on. It was all done in one day.

Chimneys

We repoint chimney stacks and repair the tops, fit cowls and caps, stop chimneys leaking and take stacks down altogether. Andy B in Grimsby had a stack removed and wrote that you couldn't tell there'd been a chimney there. In Mablethorpe we repointed a chimney and repaired the top of it, with photos before and after, and in Cleethorpes we fitted chimney cowls.

Valleys, Lead and Leaks

In Beverley a roof valley needed the timber repaired as well as the tiles. In Brigg we sorted a valley, repaired the ridge tiles and cleaned out all the gutters on one visit. In North Ferriby a broken tile turned out to be the cause of the leak, with a problem on the ridge too, and a loose chimney stack was put right at no extra cost. In Alford and Cleethorpes we've sealed leadwork.

You See What We See

We take photos of what we find on the roof and of the finished repair, so you can see the problem for yourself. Customers in Scunthorpe, Mablethorpe and Hull all mention it in their reviews.

Recent Jobs

  • Hull (HU3): a leaking chimney that was no longer in use fixed and the ridge tiles repointed, quoted on a Friday and done the next Tuesday.
  • Grimsby (DN32): a drip heard inside the chimney breast, looked at quickly and fixed a few days later.
  • Grimsby (DN36): a roof made watertight after three attempts by another builder, with a breakdown of the work and a detailed quote first.

How Long It Takes

Most of our jobs take 1 to 3 days, and a lot of repairs take less. Nikki M's job in Hull took from 9am to half past 11.

Signs a Roof Needs Repairing

  • Slipped, cracked or missing tiles or slates
  • A damp patch on a ceiling or on the chimney breast
  • Ridge or verge cement cracking or falling into the gutter
  • Crumbling pointing or a leaning pot on the chimney
  • Lead flashing that has lifted or split
